title: "Scratch Code for Simulations"
author: Casey Breen
---

Summary: Run some record linkage simulations

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(here)
library(scales)
```

```{r}
censoc_numident <- fread("/censoc/data/working_files/numident_v2.1_middle_initials.csv")
```

```{r}
censoc_numident_subset <- censoc_numident %>% 
  filter(!is.na(race) & !is.na(race_first) & middle_name_numident != "" & middle_name_census != "")
```

```{r}
analysis_sample <- censoc_numident_subset %>% 
  filter(link_abe_exact_conservative == 1) %>% 
  filter(byear %in% 1910:1915) %>% 
  filter(race %in% c(100, 200)) %>% 
  filter(race_first %in% c(1, 2)) %>% 
  mutate(race_census = case_when(
    race == 100 ~ "White",
    race == 200 ~ "Black",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>% 
  mutate(race_numident = case_when(
    race_first == 1 ~ "White",
    race_first == 2 ~ "Black",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(race_census) & !is.na(race_numident)) %>% 
  filter(middle_name_numident == middle_name_census) %>% 
  sample_n(100000)

```


```{r}
summary(lm(data = analysis_sample, death_age ~ educ_yrs + as.factor(byear)))

analysis_sample %>% 
  group_by(race_census) %>% 
  summarize(mean(race_census != race_numident)) 
``` 

```{r}
## create lists 
results_lm <- list()
results_racial_change <- list()

## carry out simulations 
for (i in seq(1500, 15000, by = 1500)) {
race_numident_resample <- c(sample(analysis_sample$race_numident[1:i]), analysis_sample$race_numident[(i+1):100000])
death_age_numident_resample <- c(sample(analysis_sample$death_age[1:i]), analysis_sample$death_age[(i+1):100000])

## create data.frame 
df <- tibble(race_numident = race_numident_resample, 
             death_age = death_age_numident_resample,
             educ_yrs = analysis_sample$educ_yrs,
             race_census = analysis_sample$race_census,
             byear = analysis_sample$byear)

## run linear model 
results_lm[[i]] <- broom::tidy(lm(death_age ~ educ_yrs + as.factor(byear), data = df)) %>% 
  filter(term == "educ_yrs") %>% 
  mutate(false_matches = i / 100000)

## calculate rates of passing 
results_racial_change[[i]] <- df %>% 
  group_by(race_census) %>% 
  summarize(race_change = mean(race_numident != race_census)) %>% 
  mutate(false_matches = i / 100000)
  
cat(i, "\n")

}

## results race change 
results_lm <- bind_rows(results_lm)
results_race_change <- bind_rows(results_racial_change)

## results 
lm_plot <- results_lm %>% 
  add_row(estimate = 0.107899, std.error = 0.005095, false_matches = 0) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = false_matches, y = estimate, ymin = estimate - 1.96 * std.error, ymax = estimate + 1.96 * std.error)) + 
    geom_line() + 
  geom_pointrange( fill = "white", shape = 21, size = 1) + 
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() + 
  ylim(0, 0.12) + 
  labs(x = "False Match Rate",
       y = "Regression Coefficient",
       title = "Education (yrs) and longevity") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.107899, color = "grey", linetype = "longdash") + 
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent)

ggsave(plot = lm_plot, filename = here("figures/lm_plot.png"), width = 6.4, height = 5)


## color scheme 
cud <- c("#D55E00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#CC79A7", "#0072B2", "#E69F00",
         "#F0E442", "#999999")

## results 
race_plot <- results_race_change %>% 
  filter(race_census == "Black") %>% 
  add_row(race_change = 0.0922, false_matches = 0) %>% 
  mutate(se = sqrt(race_change * (1-race_change) / 2000)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = false_matches, y = race_change, ymin = race_change - 1.96 * se, ymax = race_change + 1.96 * se)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_pointrange(fill = "white", size = 1, shape = 21) + 
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() + 
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6), limits = c(0, 0.42)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 23)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = cud) +  
  labs(x = "False Match Rate",
       y = "Shift in Race",
       title = "Shift in Racial Classification") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.0922, color = "grey", linetype = "longdash") + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title= element_blank()) 

ggsave(plot = race_plot, filename = here("figures/race_plot_single.png"), width = 6.4, height = 5)

```
